name: sorcha-proximity
description: BLE transport for ISO 18013-5 proximity credential presentation. Moves opaque bytes and nothing more — every byte of ISO protocol lives in C# (Sorcha.Mdoc), written once and shared by holder and reader.
author: Sorcha Contributors

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android
